column6: An owner crouched with a dog in a field; the ad is a person talking about their animal, not a product claim.
The dog going straight for the pack; enthusiasm is the only review a dog can give.
Fred lost eight pounds with before and after; the number makes an owner's vague worry measurable.
Attributed to Finn's Mom; excited for meal time again names the exact thing that stopped happening.
Clinically shown to support healthy aging; the word clinical is doing the work the photos cannot.
